purpose: API-equivalent estimate only. Subscription runs are not billed per token; this never replaces a run's usage.cost_microunits (D-094, D-085).

notes: Standard tier. The pricing page calls this promotional pricing, available at least through 2026-11-21.
Cache writes cost 1.25x the uncached input rate for GPT-5.6 and later (prompt-caching guide), so 5.00 per 1M.
Input tokens are billed at exactly one of uncached, cached-input or cache-write rates (prompt-caching guide).
The introductory 2/10 price became the standard price; the increase planned for 2026-09-01 will not occur (pricing page footnote 3).
Cache hits are 0.1x base input; 5-minute writes 1.25x; 1-hour writes 2x.
